free_tier.stated: "When using Kyma, the free plan is available only once in a global account for up to 30 days." Quoted from the pricing page: "SAP BTP trial is a non-commercial, time-limited offering that gives you 90 days... At the end of the trial period, your SAP BTP trial account will be shut down."

retention.stated: Kyma, the managed Kubernetes runtime, is free once per global account and only for 30 days, and the free tier model itself needs a Pay-As-You-Go or enterprise agreement account, so there is no renewable free cluster.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Nothing durable. A 30-day Kyma cluster is enough to test a manifest once, and the 90-day trial covers the build, which is the shape of a trial rather than a platform to run on.
